liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Blues for Allah** (1 review): Track 7 is a complete Allah into Dirt medley that moves into an interesting, melancholy passage [4]
- **Stronger than Dirt** (1 review): The session presents early exploration of new material through the Stronger than Dirt jams [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stronger than Dirt**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Stronger than Dirt**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Stronger than Dirt**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Stronger than Dirt**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Blues for Allah Reprise**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Stronger than Dirt**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Blues for Allah Reprise**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Blues for Allah**: rare: 7 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **gd75-03-21.sbd.backus.14288.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 47 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]

## Around the show

- The Dead stopped touring in October 1974 and began work toward Blues for Allah and Terrapin Station about five months later [2]
- Reviewer hears Jerry in peak form, with an exceptionally advanced musical conversation between Jerry and Phil outside a concert setting [3]
- The band practiced Stronger Than Dirt and Blues for Allah several times ahead of the Kezar Stadium show a couple days later [4]
- Reviewer says the Dead dropped acid rock for a country/folk orientation in 1970, then built up the set list for four years [2]
- Reviewer says these sessions laid foundations for the band's 1975-1982 jamming, jazzier and darker than pre-hiatus playing, yet more cohesive [3]
- Reviewer calls it one of the better 1975 studio sessions, with an unusually upbeat mood for such sessions; about 45 minutes of jamming [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd75-03-21.sbd.backus.14288.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Cassette source, then Cool Edit, MKW, and SHN; may compile several dates; tracked and re-shnd (v3) from a single SHN file by terrapinstation [1]
